## Workload

Kofi Asante graded 506 sets during 450 rostered hours. This represents a recorded throughput of 1.1 sets per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the time available for grading, with the activity recorded consistently across the period. The review did not identify a need to restate the workload figures or apply an alternative calculation.

## Quality

A sample of 31 graded sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement was 74.2 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with the discussion focused on supporting consistent decisions in similar circumstances. The findings were reviewed by Priya Anand. This review considered both the recorded level of agreement and the context of the cases examined.
